2607.16442.title: One Modality to Forget Them All: Enhancing Cross-Modal Unlearning in Vision-Language Models
2607.16442.paper_summary:
Machine unlearning is widely used to remove hazardous knowledge from large language models. Modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs), however, process both text and visual inputs, raising a fundamental security question: does unlearning in one modality transfer to the other? We present the first systematic, bidirectional study of cross-modal unlearning transfer across three VLM architectures: LLaVA-1.5 (MLP projection), InstructBLIP (Q-Former), and IDEFICS (gated cross-attention). We find that unlearning transfers across modalities, but the transfer is asymmetric and incomplete. In some cases, text unlearning strongly transfers to vision. However, this robustness is not preserved under typographic attacks that manipulate the visual presentation of text. Under such attacks, previously unlearned knowledge can be readily recovered, indicating shallow unlearning.
  To address the transfer gap and shallow robustness, we propose \textsc{CrossInf}, an influence-guided mitigation strategy. Motivated by the observation that different model components contribute unequally to cross-modal transfer, \textsc{CrossInf} focuses unlearning on transformer blocks that most influence cross-modal generalization. It reduces the transfer gap by more than half in architectures with strong fusion, while preserving model utility. It also improves robustness under typographic attacks, reducing the attack success rate to near zero. We further conduct human evaluation with three annotators ($κ{=}0.77$) to validate our findings. Finally, we analyze shallow unlearning using Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA), providing insights into the observed transfer behavior and robustness limitations.
2607.16442.paper_summary_zh: 機器遺忘廣泛用於從大型語言模型中去除危險知識。然現代視覺-語言模型（VLMs）同時處理文本和視覺輸入，提出了一個基本的安全問題：一種模態的遺忘是否會轉移到另一種模態？我們首次系統性地研究了三種VLM架構中的跨模態遺忘轉移：LLaVA-1.5（MLP投影）、InstructBLIP（Q-Former）和IDEFICS（門控交叉注意力）。我們發現遺忘在模態之間轉移，但轉移是不對稱且不完整的。在某些情況下，文本遺忘強烈轉移到視覺。然而，在操控文本視覺呈現的排版攻擊下，這種穩健性並未得到保留。在這類攻擊下，先前未學習的知識可以輕易恢復，顯示出淺層遺忘。<lb/>為了解決轉移差距和淺層穩健性，我們提出了\textsc{CrossInf}，這是一種影響引導的緩解策略。受到不同模型組件對跨模態轉移貢獻不均的觀察啟發，\textsc{CrossInf}專注於對跨模態泛化影響最大的Transformer區塊進行遺忘。它在具有強融合的架構中將轉移差距縮小了一半以上，同時保持模型效用。它還改善了在排版攻擊下的穩健性，將攻擊成功率降低到接近零。我們進一步進行了三位標註者的人工評估（$κ{=}0.77$）以驗證我們的發現。最後，我們使用中心核對齊（CKA）分析淺層遺忘，提供了對觀察到的轉移行為和穩健性限制的見解。
